channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tom Thibodeau | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tom Thibodeau from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
One day after retiring from the NBA and being named an assistant on Tiago Splitter's Bulls staff, Gibson described how Tom Thibodeau, his head coach during his early years in Chicago, reached out immediately.

“Yesterday was such a whirlwind, but one of the first calls I got was from Tom Thibodeau,”

Taj Gibson on Tom Thibodeau, Sep 16, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Fred Katz:Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau:

“I love Thibs. I'm always gonna have love for Thibs for the things he helped me with, putting me in a position to be paid.”

Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau, Sep 23, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau:

“He helped make me into the player I am. I had a lot of instability early in my career, and he gave me that opportunity to flourish. I’ll always be forever grateful for him... Always tough when there’s a coaching change.”

Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau, Jun 13, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Cameron Johnson on Steve Kerr, Mark Jackson, Nick Nurse, Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Cameron Johnson on Tom Thibodeau’s firing:

“It’s a copycat league and some teams have done it with a lot of success. You look at Golden State going from Mark Jackson to Steve Kerr, championships, dynasty run. You look at um Toronto going from Dwayne Casey to Nick Nurse and immediately coming up with a championship. So, I think that's kind of set a a precedent that like this can be a successful a a formula for winning to getting over the hump.”

Cameron Johnson on Steve Kerr, Mark Jackson, Nick Nurse, Tom Thibodeau, Jun 4, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
“I can't speak enough about the respect he has in coaching circles about the job he is able to do. You know you are in a dogfight every time you face a Thibodeau-led team, and I think he did that with the Knicks.”

JB Bickerstaff on Tom Thibodeau, Jun 4, 2025. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Tom Thibodeau, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Brunson said after practice on Friday.

“Individually, he’s meant a lot to my career. He’s meant a decent amount to [Karl-Anthony Towns], coaching KAT in Minnesota and here. There’s a lot of players who can say they’ve definitely benefited from Tom Thibodeau in his career. “But I think as a team, we’re always in a position where we can compete in the postseason, since I’ve been here. He’s very prepared, he’s a very prepared individual. He’s done a lot for my career, so I’m always going to be a supporter. Always. Even when he annoys me, always.”

Jalen Brunson on Tom Thibodeau, Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 18, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Julius Randle on Tom Thibodeau, Chris Finch
item.description:
said Randle, who averaged 22.6 points on 17.7 shots during his Knicks career.

“That’s what I genuinely like to do. That’s how I grew up playing basketball. The situation here in New York, [Tom Thibodeau] needed me to score more, and I took on that responsibility. And Jalen came along, and he took a little bit off of me, as well. But I enjoy playmaking. That’s what I enjoy doing. “And [Minnesota coach Chris Finch] is putting me in many different positions to play-make. And I’m excited to be able to show that. Not just from the post, getting double-teamed. Finch is moving me all over the floor, allowing me to be able show that stuff. I’m excited about that.”

Julius Randle on Tom Thibodeau, Chris Finch, Oct 13, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Walt Frazier on Tom Thibodeau, Red Holzman
item.description:
“I see a lot of similarities with [our] championship teams, starting with the coach. [Tom Thibodeau] is a lot like Red Holzman. He holds the guys accountable, and they’re defensive oriented, and the players actually like each other.“I think this is going to be our year. Obviously, health is going to play a big factor into it. But if the Knicks can stay healthy, I think we can get back to our former grandeur.”

Walt Frazier on Tom Thibodeau, Red Holzman, Aug 17, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Donte DiVincenzo on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Donte DiVincenzo:

“I think whatever team we have, we’re going to be very good. No matter what happens in the offseason, I think overall everyone’s going to come back and get better. I think with (Knicks head coach Tom Thibodeau) there's always a foundation, it doesn't matter who’s on the court.”

Donte DiVincenzo on Tom Thibodeau, Jul 3, 2024. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Donte DiVincenzo on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
“No matter what happens the rest of the offseason, I think overall everybody is going to come back and get better. I think with [Tom Thibodeau] there’s always a foundation, it doesn’t matter who is on the court. No matter who is on the team, I think we got a sense and we got a taste of what we can do and how we can take that next step. And I think every single person in the organization is going to do everything they can to take that next step.”

Donte DiVincenzo on Tom Thibodeau, Jul 1, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Mikal Bridges, Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Tyrese Haliburton on Mikal Bridges now playing for Tom Thibodeau:

“Mikal Bridges has missed like no games... We're testing the human ability here, because we're getting— Mikal Bridges don't miss any games, and Thibs almost play him 48 minutes, so who's gonna win”

Tyrese Haliburton on Mikal Bridges, Tom Thibodeau, Jun 27, 2024. Source: reddit.

item.title: Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Josh Hart on if he looks at Tom Thibodeau after making a bad play in a game:

“Nah I don’t really look at him too much. I hear him. Damn sure hear him. Sometimes you can’t help but hear him. I let Thibs be Thibs. Thibs gonna yell no matter what.”

Josh Hart on Tom Thibodeau, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
“Just coming from the Knicks from the past few years having a lot of wins, I’m just trying to come in and bring some of the habits that I learned under [head coach Tom Thibodeau], and try to bring a winning culture, try to get it restored and uplift everything,”

Quentin Grimes on Tom Thibodeau, Feb 27, 2024. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
One person who is impressed with what he's seen from Leon Rose so far is none other than Knicks legend Carmelo Anthony, who recently took to his 7PM in Brooklyn podcast, presented by Wave Sports + Entertainment, to heap lofty praise on the executive.

“What Leon did with the Knicks is impressive…He came in…ship was sinking…sunk…He wiped all that s**t out––front office, players…cleaned house. Imma bring in a cultural guy:[Tom Thibodeau]…hold you accountable…ain't gonna get no sleep…Now you get to mold your team the way that you want…build the pieces…draft picks…players Thibs really trusts…”

Carmelo Anthony on Tom Thibodeau, Feb 22, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Quentin Grimes on being told by Tom Thibodeau that he's moving to the bench:

“He felt like it was the best thing to do and I agree with him. It’s a good thing.”

Quentin Grimes on Tom Thibodeau, Dec 8, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Derrick Rose:

“(Thibodeau) said he wanted to give a Deuce a look. That’s all he told me. So I understood.”

Derrick Rose on Tom Thibodeau, Dec 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Mike Vorkunov:Quentin Grimes on his fit in New York:

“A match made in heaven. (Thibodeau) would be on you but they’re building something special in New York.”

Quentin Grimes on Tom Thibodeau, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Elfrid Payton on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Steve Popper:Elfrid Payton on Tom Thibodeau:

“He continues to challenge us every day. He’s always on us. He almost demands perfection. We don’t always get there, but we get close.”

Elfrid Payton on Tom Thibodeau, Feb 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @StevePopper.

item.title: Isaac Okoro on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
“Possibly playing with the Knicks would be a great opportunity for me. I know that I could come into the team and play a role that the coach needs me to play. I know that they have a new coach in Tom Thibodeau and he’s a very defensive-minded coach. I feel like me coming it would be a great opportunity.”

Isaac Okoro on Tom Thibodeau, Oct 3, 2020. Source: Forbes.com.

item.title: Leon Rose on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Mike Vorkunov:Leon Rose on Knicks HC Tom Thibodeau:

“We hire not only a great basketball coach but an elite head coach in Tom Thibodeau.”

Leon Rose on Tom Thibodeau, Jul 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Coach Pop on the Knicks' soon-to-be coach, Tom Thibodeau:

“Tommy’s a seasoned veteran who it goes without saying understands what wins and what loses. He knows how to put a program together, create a culture and be demanding -- and at the same time, make people accountable.”

Gregg Popovich on Tom Thibodeau, Jul 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Jovan Buha:Doc on Tom Thibodeau being at practices:

“He comes in and we just kind of hang out. He comes to the practices. He sits in the meeetings. ... He sits back and listens.... After practice, we’ll talk and he’ll tell me what he saw. It’s great to have him around.”

Doc Rivers on Tom Thibodeau, Nov 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Thibodeau:

“I get the biggest kick out of him. He’s the most genuine guy in the world. He doesn’t give a (bleep) what you think. He’s doing what he thinks he should do.”

Gregg Popovich on Tom Thibodeau, Nov 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Butler said after that Oct. 10 practice.

“I love this. Damn. I’m so fortunate and happy that I get to play basketball every day. And I don’t know what else to do, like it’s crazy. I’m up there with (Thibodeau).He just don’t leave the office. I leave the office, but I go home and work. I’ve got weights at the house, we got a gym right there. I’m working. I’m on you, Thibs, I’m on your tail.”

Jimmy Butler on Tom Thibodeau, Oct 18, 2017. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.

item.title: Andrew Wiggins on Tom Thibodeau, Glen Taylor
item.description:
Wiggins said in a statement released by the team.

“I love it here. The fans and organization have supported me from my first day here in Minnesota. I want to thank Glen Taylor, Tom Thibodeau, the entire coaching staff and my teammates for believing in me. We've had some good times over the last three seasons, but the best is yet to come. I look forward to doing right by them and bringing this team to the postseason.”

Andrew Wiggins on Tom Thibodeau, Glen Taylor, Oct 11, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Brad Stevens:

“After I got this job, (T-Wolves Coach Tom Thibodeau) was really helpful for me as I went through the transition.”

Brad Stevens on Tom Thibodeau, Mar 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Ricky Rubio on Thibodeau:

“I like him because he's a really basketball-savvy coach. I think the franchise has made the right choice and wants to take that step forward we need to be in the playoffs. I know Pau has told him very good things about me.”

Ricky Rubio on Tom Thibodeau, Apr 29, 2016. Source: FullBasket.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony thinks Tom Thibodeau would have accepted the Knicks' head-coaching job if it were offered him.

“I'm pretty sure in Thibodeau's situation, I'm pretty sure he wanted to come (to New York),”

Carmelo Anthony on Tom Thibodeau, Apr 28, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Glen Taylor on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
TWolves ownerGlen Taylor on Tom Thibodeau:

“He didn’t start saying other people have to work hard. He basically said I have to work hard.”

Glen Taylor on Tom Thibodeau, Apr 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Adrian Griffin on Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Adrian Griffin on his mentor Tom Thibodeau:

“He always understood the dynamics of how to pace a team over a 82-game season.”

Adrian Griffin on Tom Thibodeau, Apr 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.
